caption: The drawing depicts several pieces of wood, arranged in an abstract, vertical composition against a plain, beige background. The wood pieces are weathered, rough, and greyish-brown in color, showing visible grain, cracks, and signs of age. One central, upright wooden plank is intersected by several shorter, angled planks. Another plank, positioned near the top right, is elongated and points upward and to the right, with three holes in a row near its end. A roughly rectangular block of wood is placed near the upper part of the central plank, with a rough, irregular texture on its upper surface. The objects are all rendered with detailed shading and texture, conveying the grain, knots, and uneven surfaces of the wood. The overall setting contains no other objects or background details.
title: Wooden Plow
